# EarlyVisualAlignment

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The conserved correspondence of representational geometry in early visual areas (e.g., V1-V4) across species, despite differences in higher-order areas. Provides a stable reference point for designing neuromorphic visual front-ends that mimic conserved biological processing.
